title: publish reuses a cached clean verdict after the leak-scan rule changes, since the verdict cache key holds no scan form
goal: kbpublic's verdict cache name holds a SCAN_FORM constant beside the allowlist and pinned digest, bumped whenever file_hits' rule changes (as PROJECTION_FORM keys the projection cache), so a verdict cached under an older scan rule is never read; a test caches a clean verdict under a planted laxer file_hits, restores the real one and asserts publish refuses with leak-scan hit (guid). Found by the SP-42bn4vz7 review of BG-svpvanw4 and BG-r5wzfz3c.
